title: Project Sign 1948 report on common shapes

tellings.quote: I think it's project sign one of their first reports. I think it was late 48 but it said the the most commonly reported shapes or morphologies are silver discs and spheres and balls of fire.

plain: One of the first reports of Project Sign, an early US Air Force study of flying saucer sightings, said that the most commonly reported shapes were "silver discs and spheres and balls of fire". A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff brings this up from memory, unsure of the details, saying he thinks it dates from late 1948, and he mentions the name John Greenewald Jr. along with it. It matters to him because it shows the Air Force was cataloguing the same shapes people still describe today.
